intent: a root target silently emptied the configuration; it must not build

detail.msg:
Machine 'm' has transition(s) targeting the machine root:
  m.a: on 'E' -> target 'm' is the machine root; entering it empties the configuration. Target the roo

title: #130: `escalate` from an invoked child reaches the parent's onError
intent: the documented supervision primitive; silent loss is the worst failure mode

title: #132: an ambiguous bare `stateIn` name is rejected at first use
intent: silently picking one branch of an ambiguous guard is a wrong-branch order decision

detail.msg: 'stateIn' guard 'work' is ambiguous: it names ['m.A.left.work', 'm.A.right.work']. Use a fully qualified id.

title: #113: a non-str event `type` raises InvalidEventError (also a TypeError)
intent: a malformed event must not escape the hierarchy as a bare TypeError

title: #136: a self-referential config dict raises InvalidConfigError, not RecursionError
intent: a cyclic config must fail as a typed config error

detail.msg: State 'm.a.a' is defined by a config dict that is already one of its own ancestors (an aliased cycle). Each state must have its own config object; copy the temp

title: #133: a sendTo with no live target is observable on the receipt AND a hook
